曲／詞：Ben Manusama
中譯詞：蕭郁芸

lines.b: Who makes the sun rise

lines.a: 照耀這地 帶來全新生命
lines.b: And bring the earth new life in every beam
Jesus it is You
Who turns the day to night

lines.a: 看我安然進入甜美夢境
lines.b: And watches me as I begin to dream
Jesus it is You
Who brings me food for my table
Who cares for all of my needs
Who walks the road with me

lines.a: 伴我成長渡過一切經歷
lines.b: Has grown with me through all that I have been
Jesus it is You
Jesus it is You

lines.a: 我高舉雙手 揚聲歌唱
lines.b: So I lift my hands and I bring my song

lines.a: 一生年日 一生成敗 一切所有
lines.b: All of my days, all of my rights, all of my wrongs

lines.a: 將我的生命 完全獻上
lines.b: I offer my life, here and beyond

lines.a: 唯有祢配得 耶穌唯有祢
lines.b: To the one thing true, Jesus it is You
Who sees my brokenness

lines.a: 在軟弱無助時扶持著我
lines.b: And carries me when I am frail and weak
Jesus it is You
Who tells the storm to rest

lines.a: 在絶望恐懼時與我同在
lines.b: When I am overwhelmed and cannot speak
Jesus it is You
Who wears my guilt on His shoulders
Who holds my heart in His hands
Who takes my thoughts and fears

lines.a: 所有意念釘在十字架上
lines.b: And hangs them on the arms of calvary
Jesus it is You
Jesus it is You

lines.a: 唯有祢配得 耶穌唯有祢
lines.b: To the one thing true, Jesus it is You
